description: This file defines internal functions, types, and methods for handling YAML serialization/deserialization, including reflection-based field analysis, case-insensitive matching, and tag parsing.

methods.name: indirect
methods.description: Walks down a reflect.Value, allocating pointers as needed, until a non-pointer is reached or an Unmarshaler is encountered.

methods.name: fillField
methods.description: Fills a field struct with its byte slice and case-insensitive comparison function.

methods.name: typeFields
methods.description: Returns a list of struct fields recognized for JSON serialization, using breadth-first search over struct types.

methods.name: cachedTypeFields
methods.description: Caches and retrieves the list of fields for a given type to avoid repeated reflection work.

methods.name: isValidTag
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid JSON struct tag name.

methods.name: foldFunc
methods.description: Returns a case-insensitive comparison function based on the input byte slice, with special handling for certain ASCII characters.

methods.name: equalFoldRight
methods.description: Specialized case-insensitive comparison for ASCII strings with special folding rules.

methods.name: simpleLetterEqualFold
methods.description: Case-insensitive comparison for ASCII letters only.

methods.name: parseTag
methods.description: Splits a struct tag into its name and options.
